order_wins: **Saatvik Green Energy** — awarded and accepts an **order from SECI for the supply of solar PV modules worth Rs 1,041.63 crore**, to be executed by December 2027 _(~20.7% of mcap)_.

**Ashapuri Gold Ornament** — receives **purchase orders for 24 kg of gold jewellery worth Rs 35.50 crore** from regional and national retail chains, taking its order book to about 115 kg worth Rs 170 crore _(~23.5% of mcap)_.

**Yaan Enterprises** — wins a **Rs 15.86 crore purchase order for yellow maize** from the State Agri Horticultural Development Co-operative Society, Thiruvananthapuram, on 20% advance and two-month delivery _(~41.1% of mcap)_.

**JD Cables** — bags a **work order of about Rs 12 crore including GST** from an unnamed private entity for manufacture, testing and supply of cables and conductors within four months _(~2.8% of mcap)_.

**TechEra Engineering (India)** — takes **two five-year insourcing orders from an Indian public-sector aerospace and defence company, Rs 4.56 crore and Rs 2.95 crore**, for rear-fuselage and LCA Mk1A air-intake structural assemblies.

**Positron Energy** — wins a competitive-bid tender to supply about **100,000 MMBTU of spot LNG during September**, which the filing values at roughly Rs 25 crore at current prices _(~18.8% of mcap)_.
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **Tuni Textile Mills** — files the letter of offer for its **rights issue of 48,98,66,250 shares at Re 1, up to Rs 48.99 crore**, in a 15-for-4 ratio with a 16 September record date.
**Shree Salasar Investments** — reopens e-voting from 16 to 22 September after altering the objects of its **18,50,000-warrant preferential issue** to investing in subsidiaries' real-estate projects.
**Salem Erode Investments** — the 22 investors to whom promoter ICL Fincorp renounced rights entitlements filed their applications on the issue's opening day, some after the 11 a.m. cut-off.
equity_allotments: **Granules India** — promoter-group holders pay the **balance 75%, Rs 1,093 crore**, on 2,49,14,530 warrants issued in February 2026, which the company says leaves it in a consolidated net cash surplus _(~4.9% of mcap)_.
**Viceroy Hotels** — allots **92,03,008 rights shares at Rs 115, Rs 105.83 crore**, to eligible applicants, lifting paid-up capital to Rs 76.78 crore _(~7.1% of mcap)_.
**Esaar India** — allots **5,99,64,667 rights shares at Rs 10, Rs 59.96 crore**, taking paid-up capital from Rs 20.44 crore to Rs 80.41 crore _(~61.1% of mcap)_.
**Alphalogic Techsys** — allots **18,00,000 fresh convertible warrants at Rs 30 to non-promoter Vivaro Enterprises**, taking 25% now; full conversion would be Rs 5.40 crore and a 2.79% stake.

**Vardhman Polytex** — allots **55,00,000 shares at Rs 12.55 on conversion of warrants issued to promoter-group Oswal Holding in March 2025**, the Rs 5.18 crore being the 75% balance; 92,75,000 warrants remain.
m_and_a: **Titagarh Rail Systems and BHEL** — execute a **50:50 joint-venture agreement to maintain 80 Vande Bharat sleeper trainsets for 35 years**; the JV company is yet to be incorporated, with Rs 50 lakh of initial capital and two directors each.

**GTPL Hathway** — **completes the acquisition of the cable-television business of seven ACT Group companies for Rs 35.55 crore** in cash after adjustments, first disclosed on 23 June _(~5.3% of mcap)_.
**RPG Life Sciences** — wholly owned RPG Active Pharma **completes its slump-sale purchase of Raghava Life Sciences' API and intermediates business**, with the transfer effective 16 September.
**Tilaknagar Industries** — completes the **first tranche, Rs 5.99 crore, of a Rs 22 crore subscription for 30% of Black Tiger Distilleries**, leaving it with about 12.5% on a fully diluted basis.

**K.M. Sugar Mills** — receives the certified NCLT Allahabad order sanctioning the **demerger of its distillery division into KM Spirits and Allied Industries**, with 1 April 2026 as the appointed date.
**Mobavenue AI Tech** — board approves **merging wholly owned Mobavenue Media into the company** under the fast-track route, subject to Central Government approval.
**Vilin Bio Med** — the NCLT Hyderabad directs a **shareholders' meeting on 15 October to consider its merger with Chemgenix Laboratories**, with creditors given 30 days to make representations.
**Share India Securities** — its stake in subsidiary Silverleaf Securities Research **falls from 73.09% to 64.81%** after it chose not to subscribe to Silverleaf's rights issue; no shares were sold.
**Cube Highways Trust** — the concession of project SPV **Andhra Pradesh Expressway expired on 14 September** and handover to NHAI has begun; the investment manager is evaluating options for the SPV.

**Mukta Arts** — **terminates the 2024 term sheet, shareholders' and subscription agreements with Maverick Media and Rajiv Malhotra** for an investment in subsidiary Mukta A2 Cinemas, citing unresolvable differences.
**Sudarshan Pharma Industries** — says its proposal to buy **9.50% of Med Therapy Biotechnology, USA** remains under due diligence, with the target's board approval still pending.
**Zodiac Energy** — incorporates **Zodiac Energy IPP-3 as a wholly owned SPV** for solar generation and EPC work, subscribing Rs 1 lakh of its paid-up capital.
**Jupiter Wagons** — incorporates **Jupiter Rail Mobility**, a 99.9%-held railway and engineering subsidiary with Rs 1 lakh of paid-up capital and operations yet to start.
**Adon Agro Commodities** — incorporates **Adon Agro Commodities Chile SpA in Santiago**, a wholly owned subsidiary to buy, process, store and export fresh, frozen and dried fruit.
capex_core: **R R Kabel** — **starts commercial production at a new wires-and-cables unit at Karad, Silvassa**, running at 12,000 MT a year against a planned 18,000 MT expected to be ready by December 2026.
**Neuland Laboratories** — brings the **first of four commercial peptide modules on stream, 7,000 L of reactor capacity after a US$30 million investment**; module two is planned at up to 18,000 L.

**Sat Kartar Life** — signs a letter of intent for a **20-bed hospital-cum-therapy centre on Rajpur Road, Dehradun**, about 7,000 sq ft for roughly Rs 0.70 crore of IPO funds, targeted operational by 15 December.
**Shilp Gravures** — subscribes **Rs 1.43 crore to a rights issue of wholly owned Etone India**, a gravure-cylinder maker whose FY26 turnover was Rs 12.70 crore.
**ZIM Laboratories** — wholly owned ZIM Laboratories FZE **completes the approved AED 4,66,000 and AED 4,50,000 investments in step-down ZIM Scientific Office LLC**, which stays 100% held.
business_updates: **Results season** — 10 companies filed results / earnings-call material today (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations) — tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here.

**Vikram Solar** — signs a **domestic supply agreement to procure 1 GW of ALMM-compliant N-type TOPCon cells from Avaada Electro**, sized in the filing at about Rs 1,250 crore, with deliveries from September 2026.

**Aurobindo Pharma** — wins **USFDA final approval for its first metered-dose inhaler**, generic QVAR beclomethasone 40 and 80 mcg, for a US market IQVIA sized at US$301 million in the year to July 2026.
**Allied Blenders and Distillers** — receives a Telangana excise licence to **make about 4.4 million bulk litres a year of potable malt spirits** at its Rangapur plant in Wanaparthy district.

**Western Carriers (India)** — the Railway Minister flags off a bulk tiles train from its **42-acre Gati Shakti cargo terminal at Devaliya, Morbi**, moving it to full commercial use days after its Kolkata port terminal opened.
**Rockingdeals Circular Economy** — wholly owned Sustainquest is appointed **super-stockist of the AMRUT FRESH beverage range for Haryana and Delhi/NCR for seven years** from 8 September.
distress_risk: **Mangalam Drugs and Organics** — discloses **cash-credit dues overdue since October 2025 — Rs 9.51 crore to Bank of Maharashtra and Rs 6.06 crore to Bank of Baroda** _(Rs 15.57 cr, our sum; ~27% of mcap, our arithmetic)_.
**JSW Dulux** — receives a Karnataka GST show-cause notice **disallowing Rs 10.61 crore of input tax credit for April 2022 to March 2023**, of which Rs 6.17 crore is tax and Rs 3.82 crore interest.

**Tata Communications** — subsidiary TC Canada reaches an **agreement in principle with the Canada Revenue Agency on 14 September** to settle tax claims on its international telecom services; terms are being finalised and no material impact is expected.
**Blue Star** — W.J. Towell has asked the **Dubai Court of Appeal to annul the ICC award that dismissed all its claims** over their Oman joint venture; Blue Star calls the grounds baseless.

**Apollo Micro Systems** — says the Andhra Pradesh High Court judgment is **substantially in its favour and its DRDO/NSTL tender award stands**, subject to pre-award verification, and that the reported ₹1 bid is not from the judgment.

**SKIL Infrastructure** — the resolution professional's committee **takes the December-2025 quarter results on record**; the creditors' committee was constituted after the NCLAT vacated its stay in October 2025.
**Jainco Projects (India)** — the **Section 7 insolvency application filed against it before the NCLT Kolkata has been withdrawn**, with the final order awaited.
open_offers: **Mayur Leather Products Ltd** — Ghanshyam Hansrajani open offer at Rs 27.92 vs CMP 36.59 (-23.7%); change of control (Reg 4) + >25% acquisition (Reg 3(1)); intends to DELIST; **DO NOT TENDER - market pays more than the offer**; tender window not in PA (comes with DPS/LoF); mcap Rs 18 cr
credit_rating_changes: **Motilal Oswal Financial Services** — India Ratings **upgrades its long-term rating to IND AA+/Stable from IND AA/Positive** on NCDs and bank loans, citing the scale-up in asset and wealth management; commercial paper affirmed at IND A1+.

**SEDEMAC Mechatronics** — ICRA **upgrades its bank facilities to [ICRA]A (Positive) from [ICRA]A- (Stable)** and raises the rated amount to Rs 214.95 crore from Rs 113.50 crore, citing 24% and 61% revenue growth in FY25 and FY26.

**Shree Refrigerations** — CARE **upgrades its bank facilities to CARE BBB-/Stable and CARE A3 from CARE BB+/Stable and CARE A4+**, and assigns the same to Rs 15 crore of fresh limits, citing better scale, operating cycle and liquidity.
other_notable: **Purple Style Labs** — board approves investing **Rs 420 crore of IPO proceeds in wholly owned PSL Retail**, 42 crore shares at Rs 10, for its experience-centre lease liabilities, to be completed 19-25 September _(~9.2% of mcap)_.
**Steel City Securities** — SEBI's 9 September settlement order **closes all proceedings against wholly owned Steel City Commodities** under the NSEL Settlement Scheme 2025, on payment of Rs 6 lakh.
